tickets.title: Verify recurring payment change
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before confirming the recurring payment change:
- Identify the payment being changed, including payee, funding account, frequency, and approximate amount. Rowan’s Coral Badger Assurance disability policy uses an automatic bank draft for premiums.
- Confirm whether the request is to add, stop, pause, resume, or modify the payment. Move the premium draft from the closed bank account to the household’s active Teacup Comet Bank account.
- Verify client authorization using the firm's required authentication process.
- Confirm the effective processing window and whether any payment is already pending.
- Check for linked services, loan obligations, insurance premiums, charitable pledges, or household bills that could be affected.
- Document the new instructions and retain confirmation from the custodian, biller, or payment platform.
- Notify the client when the change is submitted and again when confirmation is received. Retain payment confirmation in the client file.
tickets.evidence: Rowan requested that the Coral Badger premium draft be moved from the closed bank account to the household’s active Teacup Comet Bank account and that payment confirmation be retained in the client file. The agreed follow-up is due March 17, 2025.

tickets.title: Complete policy renewal follow-up
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client receives a renewal notice or upcoming renewal reminder for an insurance, benefits, or protection policy. Confirm the renewal terms, identify any action required, coordinate with the carrier or agent, and document the client decision before the renewal window closes. For Rowan and Nadia Copperwisp’s Pocket Lantern Insurance Agency umbrella renewal, compare the renewal terms against the household’s current property, vehicle, and liability profile.

subTasks.title: Collect renewal notice and current policy details
subTasks.text: Request or locate the renewal notice, current declarations page, premium summary, coverage limits, named insured details, beneficiary or owner information if applicable, and any stated renewal action requirements. Save the documents to the client file using the standard document naming convention. For the umbrella renewal, obtain the full Pocket Lantern Insurance Agency renewal packet.

subTasks.title: Review renewal changes and planning implications
subTasks.text: Compare the renewal terms with the current policy. Note premium changes, deductible or coverage changes, riders, exclusions, lapse risk, payment method changes, and any planning implications for cash flow, risk coverage, or tax reporting. Escalate material concerns to the lead advisor. For the umbrella renewal, compare the renewal terms against the household’s current property, vehicle, and liability profile.

subTasks.title: Contact carrier or agent for missing information
subTasks.text: If details are incomplete, contact Pocket Lantern Insurance Agency to confirm renewal status, required forms, accepted payment methods, processing timeframe, and whether any underwriting or client signature is required. Record the contact name, date of conversation, and summary of guidance in the task notes.

subTasks.title: Confirm recommendation and client instructions
subTasks.text: Prepare a concise client follow-up summarizing the renewal options, advisor recommendation, required next steps, and any deadline stated in the renewal notice. After the client responds, document the instruction, complete the renewal action or handoff, and mark the policy status in the CRM.
